info.title: Affinidi DID Hosting — edge HTTP surface
info.description: HTTP surface of the did-hosting-server edge node: public, unauthenticated DID resolution, a liveness probe, and the HTTPS binding of the Trust Task listener. The edge is written to only by its control plane's signed Trust Tasks, which arrive over TSP, DIDComm or this binding alike.

404.description: No root DID hosted on this domain

get.summary:
Unauthenticated liveness probe; degraded while the service's own DID is
not being served.

200.description: Service is up and its own DID (if configured) resolves locally; returns status + version

503.description: Service is up but its own DID isn't being served locally, or it has not reconciled with its control plane within the staleness bound

post.summary:
Hand the posted document to the edge's one inbound dispatch and answer with
its signed reply.
post.description:
A document that does not verify gets no signed answer — a signed refusal
would settle a directive the control plane never sent — so it is answered
`403` with an unsigned, detail-free error document, which settles nothing.

400.description: The body is not a Trust Task document

403.description: The document was not accepted; an unsigned refusal

get.summary:
Combined fallback handler: walks each enabled method's dispatcher
in priority order, returning the first match.
get.description:
404 when no method recognises the URL. Callers expecting an SPA
(daemon mode) check for 404 and then call the static handler.

parameters.name: mnemonic
parameters.description: Slot path; the published did:webvh resolves at <base>/{mnemonic}/did.jsonl

200.description: did:webvh log (JSONL) or did:web document for the slot

404.description: No DID hosted at this path
